title: Entropy Production in Nonequilibrium Statistical Mechanics
exact_target: Define an experimentally meaningful entropy production rate for general stationary nonequilibrium classical systems.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 7800008 (AMR-077-0008). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Giovanni Gallavotti, original contribution to Open Problems in Mathematical Physics (1998), edited by Michael Aizenman.

status_qualification: The source also asks for general relations among stationary dynamical averages, analogous in role to equilibrium thermodynamic relations. It leaves the precise admissible model class and axioms for entropy production to the proposed theory.
